currentRoundChecks.testimonialCarousel: pass at source: both locale routes contain six semantic testimonial source cards and use the same sanitized, inert, bidirectional and resize-stable loop implementation as Location Intelligence

currentRoundChecks.cityChatContrast: pass: source-token calculations establish primary/secondary/hover contrast, and current-build computed styles confirm 10.31:1 for the dark outlined action against the beige card, 8.31:1 for secondary text against the beige card, and 9.30:1 for fit text against its local light surface in dark mode; the fixed-light card remains readable under both page themes.
